reason: Executable field-shape audit against the pinned Native and STSRL source found that the preregistration's shorthand battle HP path was imprecise. This corrects the raw-record mapping and freezes the deterministic bootstrap stream before any heldout file is opened.

field_mapping_correction.previous_shorthand: snapshot_raw.battle_player_hp when battle_active else snapshot_raw.cur_hp; snapshot_raw.max_hp when battle_active else snapshot_raw.max_hp
field_mapping_correction.implemented_mapping: snapshot_raw.battle_player.current_hp and .max_hp when battle_active; otherwise snapshot_raw.cur_hp and .max_hp
field_mapping_correction.basis: Pinned Native publicProjectionV3 reads BattleContext::player.curHp/maxHp or GameContext::curHp/maxHp. The pinned raw snapshot serializes battle-player values under battle_player.current_hp/max_hp. The redundant top-level row summaries are checked for consistency, not used as features.

bootstrap_algorithm.name: SHA-256 counter stream with replacement at owner-cluster level
bootstrap_algorithm.draw: index = big-endian first 8 bytes of SHA256(UTF8(domain + NUL + seed + NUL + stratum_key + NUL + replicate + NUL + draw_index)) modulo number_of_eligible_owners
bootstrap_algorithm.interval: linear-interpolated 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 5,000 bootstrap estimates
